sql: SELECT TOP 10 az.UserName AS userName, po.StoreCode AS storeCode FROM dbo.ZnodeUser u INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers a ON a.Id = u.AspNetUserId INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetZnodeUser az ON az.AspNetZnodeUserId = a.UserName INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUserPortal up ON up.UserId = u.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = up.PortalId WHERE u.AspNetUserId IS NOT NULL AND a.LockoutEnd IS NULL AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@preferred IS NULL OR az.UserName = @preferred) GROUP BY az.UserName, po.StoreCode ORDER BY az.UserName
